title: Authoritative apartment-planning foundation
description: M0–M7.8A established millimetre geometry, derived rooms and areas, semantic history, local projects, reference calibration, editable recognition, read-only 3D, bounded planning, explainable furniture fit and a versioned recognition benchmark.

title: M7.8B source normalization and wall topology accepted
description: Region-first structural extraction, bounded Canny/Hough fallback, fail-closed overload protection and verification-only AI were product-owner accepted with known precision limitations. Source geometry and topology F1 reached 0.837989; M7.8B remains the latest accepted recognition slice.

title: Automatic M7.8C path failed product usefulness acceptance
description: The 2026-08-08 product-owner retest on the original apartment plan rejected the automatic M7.8C direction despite green deterministic gates. PR #42, stacked benchmark PR #44 and hybrid proposal PR #45 were closed unmerged and retained only as R&D evidence; accepted M7.8B was not promoted or invalidated.

title: Assisted Tracing design gate
description: Draft PR #52 pivots the next recognition slice to Assisted Tracing from fresh main. The user explicitly chooses or draws the object; bounded local raster evidence may refine only the current ephemeral preview when unambiguous, ambiguous evidence abstains, and no AI/network dependency or product-code implementation is accepted at this design gate.

title: Approve the Assisted Tracing design, then implement it with TDD
description: Review PR #52 as a design-only boundary. After approval, create the detailed implementation plan and deliver the Assisted Tracing slice through RED→GREEN raster/transform/history contracts, Chromium/WebKit evidence and a small final product-owner retest on the original plan before any acceptance or lifecycle promotion.

title: M8.1 precision drawing accepted
description: PR #85 was product-owner accepted and merged after the M8.1 acceptance set passed 9/9. Manual editing and precision drawing are the latest accepted editor slice; Vlezet remains pre-production.

title: M8.2 top toolbar — Draft / focused retest pending
description: PR #87 is the current Draft product slice. Scenarios 01–07 passed in product-owner testing, while the focused clipboard retest is still pending. No merge, release or product-owner closure is claimed before that retest.

title: Close the M8.2 clipboard retest and acceptance boundary
description: Run the focused clipboard retest, reconcile only observed defects, then require exact-head CI and explicit product-owner closure before merge or any lifecycle promotion.
